name: OUCSS (Cyber Security Club)
notes: University club; link recovered by the link hunt. IMPORTANT MISMATCH: the batch entry labels this 'OUCSS (Open University Cyber Security Society)' with university=University of Oklahoma, Norman OK, US — but the actual club found (via oustudents.com, and its own site oucss.rocks, plus the R60 degree-pathway reference) is the UK Open University's Cyber Security Society, not University of Oklahoma.
